name: esme-recruitment-os
description: ESME Cairo University Student Chapter recruitment platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @esme/shared && npm run build -w @esme/api && npm run build -w @esme/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @esme/shared && npm run typecheck -w @esme/api && npm run typecheck -w @esme/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @esme/shared && npm run test -w @esme/api && npm run test -w @esme/web
